newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells October loading diesel in tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells October loading diesel in tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Tuesday it has tendered to sell 225-250,000 barrels of 0.3 percent sulphur diesel for October lifting.
It said the tender seeks bids for lifting fob Kaohsiung between October 1-23. The tender closes on September 17 and offers should be valid until September 19.
In its last sales tender for diesel, CPC sold 225-250,000 barrels between $25.50 and $25.55 to a Singapore-based oil trading company for lifting September 23-30.
